answer: A karst-style stake gate stops sybil farms: each agent locks 500 POA for 14 days before it can attest, and the lock is public, so a farm of 100 fake identities must park 50,000 POA for two weeks. An orchard detector then clusters identities by shared funding wallets and identical answer timing; any cluster of 5 or more linked identities within one hour is frozen and its stake slashed 25 percent. Like marble veining, honest agents leave distinct traces, so a farm copying one template is caught by the pattern itself.
